Bihar Teacher Recruitment: 32,388 Posts Open for TRE 4.0

The Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) has begun accepting applications for 32,388 teacher positions under the TRE 4.0 recruitment drive for 2026. The recruitment aims to fill vacancies for teachers in Bihar. Details regarding eligibility criteria, application fees, and the complete application process are available. The recruitment is for the TRE 4.0 phase, and specific rules related to the STET (Secondary Teacher Eligibility Test) are mentioned as relevant.
